test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'ACTING' is coded as ‘ZXGRMT’ and 'CABALS' is coded as ‘XZYZOH’. How will 'EAGLET' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e975eec7941f96b2014ca014cc7041899af15adb33154ee8a8af306f9ba4b7e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ACTING' is coded as ‘ZXGRMT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88d7cd67cb072d7fb6121556bf61637337d4ef0e006311cbf1d5ed5cfa5b8c5a.png] 

'CABALS' is coded as ‘XZYZOH’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eecb00ca7aec18d0af64dbfcf3699a5b4e655d4dd448ee339565c7b48dc3020.png] 

Similarly, '**EAGLET**' will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eecb00ca7aec18d0af64dbfcf3699a5b4e655d4dd448ee339565c7b48dc3020.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**VZTOVG**".
